All eight H5 matrices and signed Lefschetz traces reproduce \(H_4\cong A_1\oplus2A_2\oplus B_1\oplus E\) and \(H_5\cong E\). The quotient rational homology follows from finite-group averaging after barycentric subdivision. No general-n result or integral D4-lattice classification is asserted.

value.rationale: The full dihedral symmetry is intrinsic to the canonical four-by-four planar grid and its matching complex has already-known mixed-dimensional homology. Determining both complete equivariant modules, including an irreducible 2D top module and a unique invariant line in degree four, resolves the natural missing symmetry classification and determines the rational homology of its symmetry quotient. None of these outputs is implied by the previously known nonequivariant wedge or Betti table, and the precise invariant is useful for comparing equivariant structures and quotients of grid matching complexes. The claim is not framed as a routine count or arbitrary slice.
